_note: Two Baidu photos — the terminal frontage and an Ethiopian Cargo freighter on the apron — published alongside the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

add-baidu-1.webp.zh: 亚的斯亚贝巴博莱国际机场航站楼外景：多层航站楼前是车辆落客区，路边立着黑黄相间的隔离柱。
add-baidu-1.webp.en: Outside the terminal at Addis Ababa Bole International Airport — the multi-storey frontage behind a drop-off area lined with black-and-yellow bollards.

add-baidu-2.webp.zh: 埃塞俄比亚航空货运的一架货机停在机坪上，背景是外墙写有 Ethiopian Cargo 的货运库房与远处的丘陵。
add-baidu-2.webp.en: An Ethiopian Cargo freighter parked on the apron, with the Ethiopian Cargo building and distant hills behind it.

add-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，亚的斯亚贝巴博莱国际机场（ADD）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
add-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Addis Ababa Bole International Airport (ADD) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
